edit_ops.detail: The grain only needs a white-noise-looking value per pixel: a single sin-free integer-style hash (2 fract, 1 dot) replaces the 3-fract/1-dot/3-mul pcg-style hash; different noise, statistically equivalent. The vignette's length() (sqrt) is replaced by smoothstep on squared distance with squared radii, identical shape up to the smoothstep argument mapping.
